subject: Evidence request: CI credential chain, branch protection & git-blame snapshots
messages:
From: Beth Morgan <beth.morgan@finclient.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: CI credential chain & branch-protection proof for SOC2 assessor

Hi Sofia —

Our SOC2 assessor is asking for a compact bundle showing chain-of-custody for CI credentials used in production deploys, plus evidence that branch protection + merge gates are enforced for the main release branches. Specific asks: 

- A redacted trace of the CI job(s) that performed production deploys for the period 2028-06-01 -> 2028-07-15 (timestamps, job IDs, agent hostname, and credential token rotation events).
- Screenshots or policy exports showing branch protection rules (who can push, required approvals, required status checks).
- A "git-blame" snapshot for the two commits that triggered the June 28 and July 12 production deploys (show author/committer and CI trigger metadata).

Can you confirm whether you can provide a single zipped evidence bundle by COB Thursday (2028-07-19)? If any items require an internal escalation or redaction, flag them and tell us the ETA.

Thanks — Beth
Beth Morgan
Security & Risk Manager
FinClient Inc.

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Beth Morgan <beth.morgan@finclient.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: CI credential chain & branch-protection proof for SOC2 assessor

Hi Beth —

Thanks for the clear list. We can assemble an evidence bundle by COB 7/19. A couple of clarifying points before we pull artifacts: 

1) For the CI traces, do you need the full job logs or the agent-level credential rotation events only? We can provide both but will redact secrets and ephemeral token values.
2) For the git-blame snapshot, do you want the raw output from `git blame` plus the webhook payload that shows the CI trigger? Or a curated snippet with metadata (author/email/commit sha/timestamp)?
3) Are screenshots sufficient for branch-protection, or do you need the policy export from our repo host (JSON export)?

I'm attaching a quick screenshot of the current branch-protection rules for main and release/* as a stub (branch-protection-screenshot.png). Jordan will pull the CI trace + rotation events and produce a ZIP with redactions. Marissa, can you confirm whether we should include the webhook payloads or just curated CI metadata?

We will: 
- Redact token values and any IAM keys.
- Include a short manifest (manifest.txt) listing the files and redaction notes.
- Deliver a Drive link + zipped attachment to this thread.

Sofia Ivanova
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jul 2028 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: CI credential chain & branch-protection proof for SOC2 assessor

Sofia / Marissa —

I pulled the CI job traces for the requested window and extracted the credential rotation events. Attached: ci_pipeline_trace.zip (contains job_manifest.csv, rotation_events.csv, redaction_map.txt). Summary: 

- June 28 deploy: job-id deploy-prod-20280628-42, agent host infra-runner-03, rotated ephemeral deploy token at 2028-06-28T03:14:12Z.
- July 12 deploy: job-id deploy-prod-20280712-87, agent host infra-runner-04, no token rotation during the job but token created 2028-07-10T22:01:05Z (TTL 72h).

I also exported the webhook payloads for the two triggers and saved them under payloads/ (redacted). Link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2bCI-credentials-log — note the drive contains manifest.txt, rotation_events.csv, webhook_payloads_redacted.json.

I've added this to JIRA-9982 for tracking (internal ticket includes the extraction steps and who to contact if the assessor asks for raw logs). If the assessor wants raw job logs, we need a signed NDA addendum — those logs contain internal hostnames and stack traces that are normally redacted for external sharing.

Jordan Blake
Sr. Platform Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Beth Morgan <beth.morgan@finclient.com>, audit@secureassess.co
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jul 2028 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: CI credential chain & branch-protection proof for SOC2 assessor

Beth / SecureAssess —

Per your request, attached is the compiled evidence bundle (ci_pipeline_trace.zip, branch-protection-screenshot.png). Deliverables included in the bundle: 

- manifest.txt — explains each file and the scope of redactions applied.
- rotation_events.csv — lists token creation/rotation timestamps and associated job IDs (token values redacted).
- webhook_payloads_redacted.json — contains webhook metadata for the two deploy triggers.
- branch-protection-screenshot.png — current required reviewers and required status checks for main and release/* branches.

We have intentionally redacted ephemeral tokens and any full stack traces. If you need unredacted job logs for internal audit purposes, please confirm that FinClient will sign the addendum we mentioned; Jordan has flagged the internal JIRA (JIRA-9982) for a secure transfer if that becomes necessary.

Next steps: 
- If assessor has questions about the rotation cadence or wants corroborating evidence from our KMS, let us know and we will coordinate a scoped export.
- We are available for a 30-min walkthrough with the assessor on Friday 7/20 to explain the manifest and the redaction map.

Thanks —

Sofia Ivanova
Director, Platform Security | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
attachments: ci_pipeline_trace.zip (application/zip), branch-protection-screenshot.png (image/png)
